{{Article header|eyebrow=EDFM // Field Procedure|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Ram Tah — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Ram Tah]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Ram Tah]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Ram Tah]]'s Engineer services at [[Phoenix Base]] in [[Meene]].

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Ram Tah is discovered through [[Lei Cheung]].
* '''Invitation:''' Reach the Pilots Federation '''Exploration rank of Surveyor''' or higher.
* Reach '''Grade 3 access and at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Lei Cheung]].
* Reach '''Surveyor''' or higher in Exploration Rank.
* Obtain '''50 [[Classified Scan Databanks]]'''.
* Provide the 50 Classified Scan Databanks to Ram Tah.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
'''Obtaining Classified Scan Databanks'''
Classified Scan Databanks are '''Encoded''' materials in the Data Archives category.

Current material data lists them as obtainable from:

* basic ship scans, particularly transport vessels;
* certain surface points of interest; or
* trading other Encoded materials through an Encoded Material Trader.

See [[Classified Scan Databanks]] for current collection methods and efficient ways to obtain the full 50 units.

{{Tip|Because Classified Scan Databanks are stored in your Engineering-material inventory rather than your cargo hold, you do '''not''' need to fit cargo racks to transport them to Phoenix Base.}}

{{Field note|Current Engineer data notes that station services may not become available immediately after Ram Tah is unlocked. If the workshop or other expected services do not appear after completing the unlock, logging out and back in may make them available.}}

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Reach '''Grade 3 access and at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Lei Cheung]].
# Receive Lei's referral to Ram Tah.
# Reach '''Surveyor''' or higher in Exploration Rank.
# Obtain '''50 [[Classified Scan Databanks]]'''.
# Travel to '''Phoenix Base''' in [[Meene]].
# Provide the 50 Classified Scan Databanks to Ram Tah.
# Enter the Engineer workshop and begin increasing your reputation with Ram Tah.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Ram Tah]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
